dedupe_keys.name: ifpri impact projections of demand for agricultural products to 2030 and 2050 2017 global food policy report annex

description: This dataset gives the International Food Policy Research Institute's projections of total demand, and a demand index, for agricultural commodities to 2030 and 2050, by region and for selected countries. It is an extended country-level annex to IFPRI's 2017 Global Food Policy Report and was published on Harvard Dataverse in 2017. The projections come from IMPACT, IFPRI's partial equilibrium, multimarket model of national and international agricultural markets, linked to climate, water and crop models and developed with the CGIAR research centres. Two baseline scenarios are given, one with climate change impacts and one without. The file is a small Excel workbook, free to download online under custom terms of use set on Dataverse. Caveats: results are scenario projections of one model version, and later report editions revise them. Simulation uses: demand trajectories for long-run food supply capacity and trade scenarios. Related records: IFPRI IMPACT projections of production, consumption and net trade (data-ifpri-impact-projections-food-net-trade-2050) come from the 2019 report, and the Global Food Security Projections Database (data-global-food-security-projections-database) harmonises several models.
